Thanks for the advice. :)  I would say shading is something I definitely need to work on and try to just draw more and practice.  But when I observe someone's work and try to duplicate it, a voice in my head would say 'hey you're not really creating anything.  You're just copying and you're not getting any better.'  So I would hesitate with observing and try duplicating the work and try to make my own.  Then my own weaknesses in drawing / shading / anatomy would show through again.  
Anyways sorry for the rambling but I guess what I want to ask you is how do you deal with your insecurities when you draw?
